question: Who was named Songwriter of the Year at the 2025 Ivor Novello Awards, held at Grosvenor House, London?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charli XCX**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Charli XCX**, the British singer-songwriter, was named **Songwriter of the Year** at the 2025 Ivor Novello Awards, held at Grosvenor House, London.
 
• The Ivor Novello Awards are one of the most prestigious accolades recognizing excellence in songwriting and composing in the UK.
 
• Charli XCX, known for her innovative and genre-defying music, was recognized for her contributions to several hit songs, reflecting her influence in shaping modern pop music.
 
• She has consistently delivered critically acclaimed albums and singles, including her 2022 album **"Crash"**, which showcased her evolution as an artist.
 
• Her ability to write compelling lyrics and create unique melodies has earned her widespread recognition and a dedicated fan base.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ed Sheeran**

 
 
• Ed Sheeran is one of the world's most successful singer-songwriters, known for hits like **"Shape of You"**, **"Thinking Out Loud"**, and **"Perfect"**.
 
• He has won multiple Ivor Novello Awards in the past, including **Songwriter of the Year** in previous editions.
 
 
 
• **Sam Smith**
 
 
• Sam Smith is a Grammy-winning artist known for their soulful voice and emotional ballads such as **"Stay With Me"** and **"Too Good at Goodbyes."**
 
 
 
• **RAYE**
 
 
• RAYE is a British singer and songwriter who gained recognition for her work on hits like **"Secrets"** and **"Escapism."**
 
• She has been vocal about her struggles in the music industry and has emerged as an independent artist with a growing reputation for her songwriting skills.
